description: This file defines classes and methods related to the MapWithStateDStream in Apache Spark Streaming, implementing stateful stream processing with per-key state management and snapshot capabilities.

classes.name: MapWithStateDStream
classes.description: Abstract class representing a DStream that provides access to state snapshots and supports mapWithState operations.

classes.name: MapWithStateDStreamImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of MapWithStateDStream, managing internal state and providing snapshot functionality.

classes.name: InternalMapWithStateDStream
classes.description: Internal class that manages per-key state, data partitioning, and RDD generation for mapWithState operations.

methods.name: stateSnapshots
methods.description: Returns a DStream of key-state pairs representing the current snapshot of all key states.

methods.name: slideDuration
methods.description: Returns the slide duration of the internal stream.

methods.name: dependencies
methods.description: Lists dependencies of the stream, typically the parent or internal streams.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Generates an RDD for the given valid time, representing the mapped data.

methods.name: checkpoint
methods.description: Sets the checkpoint interval for the stream.

methods.name: keyClass
methods.description: Returns the runtime class of the key type.

methods.name: valueClass
methods.description: Returns the runtime class of the value type.

methods.name: stateClass
methods.description: Returns the runtime class of the state type.

methods.name: mappedClass
methods.description: Returns the runtime class of the mapped data type.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the internal state, setting checkpoint duration if not set.

methods.name: createFromRDD
methods.description: Creates a new MapWithStateRDD from an existing RDD, used for restoring previous state.

methods.name: createFromPairRDD
methods.description: Creates a new MapWithStateRDD from a pair RDD, used for initializing state.
